entries.description: A smoother player, more lyric choices, and saved streams you can replay offline

changelog.title: New
items: Choose how much space LuvLyrics uses to save streamed songs, then replay saved songs without using data
Translate lyrics or read them in Roman letters using an AI key you add
Choose a Tamil or English lyric match when the song page has both

changelog.title: Improved
items: The player follows your finger up or down and settles smoothly, ending on one mini player
Stream puts your profile at the top left and Devices with the LuvLyrics logo at the top right
Songs and Playlists stay the same size when selected
New versions appear in About more reliably

entries.description: App updates appear more reliably, with clearer Search messages and easier controls

changelog.title: New
items: Connect ListenBrainz in Settings to keep a copy of what you listen to on your own profile
Your full history stays on this phone, and nothing is sent until you connect

changelog.title: Improved
items: The app finds new versions reliably, so updates show up in About
Search tells you when the catalog cannot be reached, with a Try again button
The close button on the info card works
Small buttons are easier to tap, including the info buttons and filter chips
Text in Search and the Now Playing controls no longer gets cut off at larger sizes
